text: This year-end report provides an update to the Board on the final progress of the 2024 Capital Works Program State of Good Repair Budget. The 2024 Capital Works Program budget consists of two parts totalling $49,268,618: 1. Exhibition Place Managed Projects which includes the “State-of-Good-Repair” ("SOGR") 2024 program with a budget of $20,080,000 (Table 1 - Appendix A); and the 2023 total cash flow carry forward of $3,791,143 (Table 2 - Appendix A). 2. Non-Exhibition Place Managed Projects which includes $25,397,475 for Service Improvements relating to BMO Field improvements in support of Toronto's hosting of FIFA World Cup 2026. A cash flow carry forward in this report is defined as the combination of unspent mostly committed costs from prior year through signed contracts and agreements, and any surplus from the above SOGR program projects.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (April 10, 2025) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, for information.
